card.name: Missed-dose instructions: what to do next
card.fires_on: Words inside missed-dose instructions where the text is about to say when to take or skip the dose, such as "as soon as possible", "should", "to" or a comma after a time limit.

modes.label: as soon as possible
modes.description: The word "possible" ending "as soon as" in a missed-dose instruction.
modes.example: If a dose is missed, administer as soon as<< possible>>. However, if the next scheduled dose

modes.label: skip-the-dose verbs
modes.description: "should" or "to" after a patient who is past the time window, just before skip or take instructions.
modes.example: instruct the patient<< to>> skip the dose and take the next dose

modes.label: comma after a time limit
modes.description: A comma after a clause about hours remaining or elapsed, before the instruction for the next dose.
modes.example: If less than 4 hours remain before the next scheduled dose<<,>> wait until the next scheduled dose.
